title: Moen Smyth™ Bathroom Collection
summary: A New Era of Quiet Luxury: Moen Introduces the Smyth™ Bathroom Suite
body_markdown:
### Delivering a Harmony of Tailored Elegance and Vintage Charm


After bringing tailored elegance to the kitchen, the[Smyth™ Bathroom Collection](https://www.moen.com/collections/smyth-bath) now extends into the bath. The suite reimagines traditional design through a contemporary lens, with fluted handles inspired by ornate furniture knobs, sculpted spouts, and rich architectural details roots in history.


The collection includes faucets, shower fixtures, and matching accessories like robe hooks and grab bars, so every element of the bath can share one cohesive look.


The Smyth™ Bathroom Collection is available in Chrome, Matte Black, Polished Nickel, Brushed Nickel, and Bronzed Gold.
